#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Single-pass reviewed-repo automation controller.

This script intentionally owns the loop boundary. It performs one bounded
discovery pass, applies at most the needed schedule changes, writes one memory
entry, and exits.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


ROOT = Path("/Users/teacher/.codex/automations")
MEMORY = ROOT / "reviewed-repo-automation-controller" / "memory.md"
ORPHAN_MEMORY = ROOT / "reviewed-repo-orphan-pr-steward" / "memory.md"
MAINTENANCE_MEMORY = ROOT / "sync-dependabot-pr-closer/memory.md"
CODE_ROOT = Path("/Users/teacher/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Learning/Code")
APPROVED_QUEUE = (
    CODE_ROOT
    / "Workflows-steward/docs/reports/repo-review/approved-issue-queue.json"
)
HANDOFF = Path("/Users/teacher/.codex/handoff/lane-handoff.json")

TARGETS = {
    "opener": ROOT / "pd-workloop-resume/automation.toml",
    "closer": ROOT / "imi-merge-verify-closer/automation.toml",
    "maintenance": ROOT / "sync-dependency-pr-closer/automation.toml",
    "orphan": ROOT / "reviewed-repo-orphan-pr-steward/automation.toml",
    "escalator": ROOT / "reviewed-repo-stall-escalator/automation.toml",
}

RRULES = {
    "opener_active": "FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYMINUTE=0",
    "closer_active": "FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYMINUTE=20",
    "opener_dormant": "FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=6;BYMINUTE=0",
    "closer_dormant": "FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=6;BYMINUTE=20",
    "maintenance_active": "FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYMINUTE=1,16,31,46",
    "maintenance_dormant": "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;BYHOUR=1;BYMINUTE=0",
    "orphan_active": "FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYMINUTE=40",
    "orphan_dormant": "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;BYHOUR=1;BYMINUTE=40",
    "escalator_active": "FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYMINUTE=50",
}

EXCLUDED_REPO = "stranske/Collab-Deliverables"
ADMIN_REPO = "stranske/Collab-Admin"
WORKFLOWS_REPO = "stranske/Workflows"
RUN_DIR = Path("/private/tmp/reviewed-repo-automation-controller")
FRESH_GUARD_SECONDS = 30 * 60
ORPHAN_WORKER_NOOP_FRESH_SECONDS = 30 * 60
MAINTENANCE_EARLY_START_SECONDS = 6 * 24 * 60 * 60


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Schedule:
    status: str
    rrule: str
    updated_at: int | None = None


def iso_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def parse_iso(ts: str) -> float | None:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp()
    except ValueError:
        return None


def run(cmd: list[str], timeout: int = 120) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(CODE_ROOT),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr


def load_toml_schedule(path: Path) -> Schedule:
    text = path.read_text()
    status = re.search(r'^status\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.M)
    rrule = re.search(r'^rrule\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.M)
    updated = re.search(r"^updated_at\s*=\s*(\d+)", text, re.M)
    return Schedule(
        status.group(1) if status else "UNKNOWN",
        rrule.group(1) if rrule else "UNKNOWN",
        int(updated.group(1)) if updated else None,
    )


def read_schedules() -> dict[str, Schedule]:
    return {name: load_toml_schedule(path) for name, path in TARGETS.items()}


def schedule_payload(schedules: dict[str, Schedule]) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    return {name: {"status": sched.status, "rrule": sched.rrule} for name, sched in schedules.items()}


def memory_sections() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    if not MEMORY.exists():
        return []
    text = MEMORY.read_text()
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"^##\s+(\S+)\s*$", text, re.M))
    sections: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for i, match in enumerate(matches):
        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)
        sections.append((match.group(1), text[match.start() : end].rstrip()))
    return sections


def newest_fresh_decision() -> tuple[str, str, float] | None:
    for ts, body in memory_sections():
        lower = body.lower()
        if "duplicate-run guard suppressed" in lower:
            continue
        if "issue-work event trigger" in lower:
            continue
        if "config-maintenance" in lower or "permanent loop fix" in lower:
            continue
        if all(label in body for label in ("Issue work signal", "Maintenance work signal", "Orphan PR steward signal")):
            parsed = parse_iso(ts)
            if parsed is not None:
                return ts, body, parsed
    return None


def prepend_memory(entry: str) -> None:
    old = MEMORY.read_text() if MEMORY.exists() else ""
    MEMORY.write_text(entry.rstrip() + "\n\n" + old)


def gh_graphql(query: str, q: str, out_path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    """Fetch a complete search, or reject the inventory instead of classifying a prefix."""
    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen_urls: set[str] = set()
    seen_cursors: set[str] = set()
    cursor = None
    expected = None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60

    def incomplete(reason: str) -> tuple[None, str]:
        out_path.write_text(json.dumps({"complete": False, "error": reason,
                                        "fetched_count": len(nodes), "issueCount": expected}))
        return None, reason

    for page in range(1, 11):
        remaining = int(deadline - time.monotonic())
        if remaining <= 0:
            return incomplete("search pagination exceeded 60-second deadline")
        cmd = ["gh", "api", "graphql", "-f", f"query={query}", "-f", f"q={q}"]
        if cursor is not None:
            cmd.extend(["-f", f"after={cursor}"])
        try:
            code, stdout, stderr = run(cmd, timeout=remaining)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return incomplete("search pagination timed out")
        if code != 0:
            return incomplete(stderr.strip() or f"gh exited {code}")
        try:
            data = json.loads(stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            return incomplete(f"invalid JSON: {exc}")
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("errors"):
            return incomplete("GraphQL returned errors or an invalid response")
        search = (data.get("data") or {}).get("search")
        if not isinstance(search, dict) or not isinstance(search.get("issueCount"), int) or not isinstance(search.get("nodes"), list):
            return incomplete("missing data.search.issueCount or data.search.nodes")
        count = search["issueCount"]
        if expected is not None and count != expected:
            return incomplete("search count changed during pagination; retry a fresh inventory")
        expected = count
        if count > 1000:
            return incomplete("search exceeds GitHub's 1000-result limit; partition the query")
        for node in search["nodes"]:
            url = node.get("url") if isinstance(node, dict) else None
            if not url or url in seen_urls:
                return incomplete("search returned missing or duplicate issue identities")
            seen_urls.add(url)
            nodes.append(node)
        info = search.get("pageInfo") or {}
        if not isinstance(info.get("hasNextPage"), bool):
            return incomplete("search response lacks pagination evidence")
        if not info["hasNextPage"]:
            if len(nodes) != expected:
                return incomplete(f"search count mismatch: fetched {len(nodes)} of {expected}")
            result = {"issueCount": expected, "nodes": nodes, "complete": True,
                      "fetched_count": len(nodes), "page_count": page}
            out_path.write_text(json.dumps({"data": {"search": result}}))
            return result, None
        cursor = info.get("endCursor")
        if not cursor or cursor in seen_cursors or not search["nodes"]:
            return incomplete("search pagination made no progress")
        seen_cursors.add(cursor)
    return incomplete("search pagination exceeded 10 pages")


def labels(node: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [x.get("name", "") for x in node.get("labels", {}).get("nodes", [])]


def repo(node: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return node.get("repository", {}).get("nameWithOwner", "")


def author_login(node: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return (node.get("author") or {}).get("login", "").lower()


def node_text(node: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return " ".join(
        [
            node.get("title") or "",
            node.get("body") or "",
            node.get("headRefName") or "",
            " ".join(labels(node)),
        ]
    ).lower()


def maintenance_category(node: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
    title = (node.get("title") or "").lower()
    branch = (node.get("headRefName") or "").lower()
    login = author_login(node)
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    if title.startswith("chore: sync workflow templates"):
        return "sync-generated"
    if title.startswith("deps: sync dev tool versions") or branch.startswith("deps/sync-dev-versions-"):
        return "dev-tool-sync"
    # Source repairs opened by the sync-maintenance campaign are part of the
    # same owned lifecycle as their generated consumer PRs.  Without this
    # branch/title rule, a live Maint 68/71 repair is classified as a quiet
    # orphan and can leave the real maintenance owner invisible to scheduling.
    if repo(node) == WORKFLOWS_REPO and (
        branch.startswith("automation/maint")
        or (
            title.startswith(("fix(sync):", "chore(sync):"))
            and "codex-automation" in lower_labels
        )
    ):
        return "dev-tool-sync"
    if "renovate" in login or "dependabot" in login or branch.startswith(("renovate/", "dependabot/")):
        return "dependency-bot"
    return None


def is_issue_linked_pr(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    text = node_text(node)
    branch = (node.get("headRefName") or "").lower()
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    if re.search(r"(close[sd]?|fix(e[sd])?|resolve[sd]?|related to|part of|stacked on)\s+#\d+", text):
        return True
    if re.search(r"\[#\d+\]|issue-\d+|meta:issue:\d+", text) or re.search(r"issue-\d+", branch):
        return True
    if "generated with claude code" in text or "generated by claude" in text or "generated by codex" in text:
        return True
    return any(label.startswith(("agent:", "agents:")) or label in {"autofix", "from:codex"} for label in lower_labels)


def is_release_pr(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    title = (node.get("title") or "").lower()
    text = node_text(node)
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    return (
        title.startswith("chore(main): release")
        or "release-please" in text
        or any(label.startswith("autorelease:") for label in lower_labels)
    )


def is_generated_or_durable_pr(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if repo(node) == ADMIN_REPO:
        return True
    text = node_text(node)
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    title = (node.get("title") or "").lower()
    if "dashboard" in text or "metrics" in text or "tracker:durable" in lower_labels:
        return True
    if title.startswith("agent metrics weekly summary"):
        return True
    if is_release_pr(node):
        return True
    return False


def is_actionable_orphan_candidate(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if node.get("isDraft"):
        return False
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    text = node_text(node)
    if "hold" in lower_labels or "do-not-merge" in lower_labels or "blocked" in lower_labels:
        return False
    if is_release_pr(node):
        return True
    return any(label in {"agent:needs-attention", "autofix:escalated"} for label in lower_labels) or "needs attention" in text


def is_actionable_issue_pr_candidate(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """Issue-linked PRs belong to opener/closer, but should still wake them."""
    if repo(node) == ADMIN_REPO:
        return False
    if is_release_pr(node):
        return False
    return is_issue_linked_pr(node)


def classify_prs(
    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]],
    scoped: set[str],
    challenge_due: set[str] | None = None,
    retry_due: set[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[Counter[str], Counter[str], dict[str, list[str]]]:
    buckets: Counter[str] = Counter()
    maintenance: Counter[str] = Counter({"sync-generated": 0, "dev-tool-sync": 0, "dependency-bot": 0})
    samples: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    challenge_due = challenge_due or set()
    retry_due = retry_due or set()
    for node in nodes:
        r = repo(node)
        url = node.get("url", "")
        if r == ADMIN_REPO:
            continue
        if r == EXCLUDED_REPO:
            buckets["excluded"] += 1
            continue
        key = f"{r}#{node.get('number')}"
        maint = maintenance_category(node)
        if r != ADMIN_REPO and maint:
            maintenance[maint] += 1
            buckets["maintenance-worker-scope"] += 1
            samples["maintenance"].append(url)
            continue
        if key in challenge_due:
            buckets["automation-challenge-due"] += 1
            buckets["orphan-steward-scope"] += 1
            buckets["actionable_orphan_steward_scope"] += 1
            samples["challenge_due"].append(url)
            samples["orphan"].append(url)
            continue
        if key in retry_due:
            buckets["automation-retry-due"] += 1
            buckets["orphan-steward-scope"] += 1
            buckets["actionable_orphan_steward_scope"] += 1
            samples["retry_due"].append(url)
            samples["orphan"].append(url)
            continue
        if key in scoped:
            buckets["scoped-blocked"] += 1
            samples["scoped"].append(url)
            continue
        # Release PRs can contain changelog text that GitHub interprets as
        # closing references. Route them to the release/orphan steward before
        # generic issue-lineage classification; otherwise clean release PRs
        # are misrouted to the issue workloop and can sit indefinitely.
        if is_release_pr(node):
            buckets["orphan-steward-scope"] += 1
            if is_actionable_orphan_candidate(node):
                buckets["actionable_orphan_steward_scope"] += 1
            samples["orphan"].append(url)
            continue
        if is_issue_linked_pr(node):
            buckets["issue-workloop-scope"] += 1
            if is_actionable_issue_pr_candidate(node):
                buckets["actionable_issue_workloop_pr_scope"] += 1
            samples["issue_pr"].append(url)
            continue
        if is_actionable_orphan_candidate(node):
            buckets["orphan-steward-scope"] += 1
            buckets["actionable_orphan_steward_scope"] += 1
            samples["orphan"].append(url)
            continue
        if is_generated_or_durable_pr(node):
            buckets["durable/generated/repo-management"] += 1
            samples["durable"].append(url)
            continue
        buckets["orphan-steward-scope"] += 1
        samples["orphan"].append(url)
    return buckets, maintenance, {k: v[:8] for k, v in samples.items()}


def issue_category(node: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if repo(node) in {EXCLUDED_REPO, ADMIN_REPO}:
        return "excluded"
    text = node_text(node)
    title = (node.get("title") or "").lower()
    login = author_login(node)
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    if "dependency dashboard" in title or ("renovate" in login and "dashboard" in title):
        return "dependency-dashboard"
    if "blocked epic" in title:
        return "blocked-epic"
    if "sync drift detected" in text:
        return "operational-alert"
    if "metrics" in text or "dashboard" in text or "weekly summary" in text or "langsmith fleet coverage" in text:
        return "metrics-data"
    if "tracker:durable" in lower_labels or "campaign" in text or "tracker" in text:
        return "tracker"
    if "sync failed" in text or "alert" in text or "expiry" in text or "outage" in text:
        return "operational-alert"
    if "epic" in title:
        return "epic"
    if any(label in lower_labels for label in ("enhancement", "bug", "repo-review-approved")) or title.startswith(
        (
            "[minor]",
            "[deployment-hardening]",
            "[enhancement]",
            "[audit ",
            "[capability pilot]",
            "correct ",
            "legacy removal",
            "verifier follow-up",
        )
    ):
        return "issue-implementation"
    return "other"


def classify_issues(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Counter[str]:
    return Counter(issue_category(node) for node in nodes if repo(node) != ADMIN_REPO)


ISSUE_STATE_NEXT_ACTIONS = {
    "automation-ready": "Issue workloop opener selects and routes the next bounded item.",
    "in-flight-or-dispositioned": "Issue workloop/closer follows the recorded PR, verifier, or disposition until completion.",
    "automation-challenge-due": "Automation independently challenges the claimed human boundary and routes any solvable work.",
    "automation-retry": "Owning automation retries after the recorded TTL or clears the mechanical blocker on recovery.",
    "human-input-required": "Human supplies the exact recorded decision; opener re-evaluates on its next run.",
    "durable-holder": "Keep open as durable state; monitoring automation updates it and routine delivery must not close it.",
    "generated-exclusion": "Generated-system owner refreshes it; issue workloop intentionally does not implement it.",
    "policy-exclusion": "Review the policy disposition before routing or retaining the exclusion.",
    "outside-opener-scope": "Review repository coverage; add it to the supported set or assign a concrete alternate worker.",
    "unmapped-supported": "Repair the controller/guard mapping because a supported-repository issue lacks an automation disposition.",
}


def issue_automation_summary(
    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], liveness: dict[str, Any] | None
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    state_by_target: dict[tuple[str, int], str] = {}
    if liveness:
        state_sources = (
            ("actionable_candidates", "automation-ready"),
            ("dispositioned_candidates", "in-flight-or-dispositioned"),
            ("challenge_due", "automation-challenge-due"),
            ("automation_retry", "automation-retry"),
            ("human_attention", "human-input-required"),
            ("durable_holders", "durable-holder"),
            # These remain durable holders: the guard emits them separately so
            # it can report their long-horizon evidence dependency without
            # turning them into immediate human-input requests.
            ("standing_human_dependencies", "durable-holder"),
            ("generated_exclusions", "generated-exclusion"),
            ("policy_exclusions", "policy-exclusion"),
        )
        for source, state in state_sources:
            for item in liveness.get(source) or []:
                try:
                    key = (str(item.get("repository") or ""), int(item.get("number")))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                state_by_target[key] = state

    supported = set(liveness.get("supported_repos") or []) if liveness else set()
    grouped: dict[str, Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
    for node in nodes:
        if repo(node) == ADMIN_REPO:
            continue
        category = issue_category(node)
        key = (repo(node), int(node.get("number") or 0))
        state = state_by_target.get(key)
        if state is None:
            state = "unmapped-supported" if key[0] in supported else "outside-opener-scope"
        grouped[category][state] += 1

    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for category in sorted(grouped):
        states = grouped[category]
        result[category] = {
            "total": sum(states.values()),
            "automation_states": dict(sorted(states.items())),
            "next_actions": [
                ISSUE_STATE_NEXT_ACTIONS[state]
                for state in ISSUE_STATE_NEXT_ACTIONS
                if states.get(state, 0) > 0
            ],
        }
    return result


def pr_automation_summary(
    buckets: Counter[str],
    maintenance: Counter[str],
    schedules: dict[str, Schedule],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    issue_count = buckets.get("issue-workloop-scope", 0)
    actionable_issue_count = buckets.get("actionable_issue_workloop_pr_scope", 0)
    maintenance_count = buckets.get("maintenance-worker-scope", 0)
    orphan_count = buckets.get("orphan-steward-scope", 0)
    actionable_orphan_count = (
        buckets.get("actionable_orphan_steward_scope", 0)
        + buckets.get("unassigned-review", 0)
    )
    scoped_count = buckets.get("scoped-blocked", 0)
    durable_count = buckets.get("durable/generated/repo-management", 0)
    return {
        "issue-workloop": {
            "total": issue_count,
            "actionable": actionable_issue_count,
            "worker_state": (
                "ACTIVE"
                if schedules["opener"].status == "ACTIVE"
                and schedules["closer"].status == "ACTIVE"
                and schedules["opener"].rrule == RRULES["opener_active"]
                and schedules["closer"].rrule == RRULES["closer_active"]
                else "DORMANT"
            ),
            "next_action": (
                "Opener/closer reviews, fixes, merges, and verify:compare-completes the issue-linked PR queue."
                if issue_count
                else "No issue-linked PR action sampled."
            ),
        },
        "maintenance": {
            "total": maintenance_count,
            "actionable": maintenance_count,
            "worker_state": (
                "ACTIVE"
                if schedules["maintenance"].status == "ACTIVE"
                and schedules["maintenance"].rrule == RRULES["maintenance_active"]
                else "DORMANT"
            ),
            "types": dict(maintenance),
            "next_action": (
                "Maintenance worker processes sync, dev-tool, and dependency PRs through checks and ownership rules."
                if maintenance_count
                else "No maintenance PR action sampled."
            ),
        },
        "orphan-steward": {
            "total": orphan_count,
            "actionable": actionable_orphan_count,
            "automation_challenge_due": buckets.get("automation-challenge-due", 0),
            "automation_retry_due": buckets.get("automation-retry-due", 0),
            "worker_state": (
                "ACTIVE"
                if schedules["orphan"].status == "ACTIVE"
                and schedules["orphan"].rrule == RRULES["orphan_active"]
                else "DORMANT"
            ),
            "next_action": (
                "Orphan steward independently challenges stale human-authority claims, retries due automation blockers, and routes each actionable release/unassigned PR to merge, repair, or a concrete blocker."
                if orphan_count
                else "No orphan-steward PR action sampled."
            ),
        },
        "scoped-blocked": {
            "total": scoped_count,
            "actionable": 0,
            "worker_state": "HELD",
            "next_action": "Clear or revalidate the recorded scoped blocker; the owning worker then resumes.",
        },
        "durable-generated-repo-management": {
            "total": durable_count,
            "actionable": 0,
            "worker_state": "MONITORED",
            "next_action": "Leave generated/status PRs with their designated management owner unless an attention signal appears.",
        },
        "stall-escalation-backstop": {
            "total": issue_count + maintenance_count + orphan_count,
            "actionable": 0,
            "worker_state": (
                "ACTIVE"
                if schedules["escalator"].status == "ACTIVE"
                and schedules["escalator"].rrule == RRULES["escalator_active"]
                else "DORMANT"
            ),
            "next_action": (
                "Independently diagnose any PR whose ordinary owner records no concrete action, then repair the automation contract, wake an owner, or record a genuine blocker."
            ),
        },
    }


def scoped_blocker_states() -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str]]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(HANDOFF.read_text())
    except Exception:
        return set(), set(), set()
    blockers = (data.get("stop") or {}).get("scoped_blockers") or {}
    held: set[str] = set()
    challenge_due: set[str] = set()
    retry_due: set[str] = set()
    now = time.time()
    for target, entry in blockers.items():
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            held.add(target)
            continue
        if entry.get("await_human") is True:
            if entry.get("human_confirmed") is True or entry.get("attention_state") == "human-confirmed":
                held.add(target)
            else:
                challenge_due.add(target)
            continue
        expires_at = parse_iso(str(entry.get("expires_at") or ""))
        if expires_at is not None and expires_at <= now:
            retry_due.add(target)
        else:
            held.add(target)
    return held, challenge_due, retry_due


def run_json(cmd: list[str], timeout: int = 25) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        code, stdout, stderr = run(cmd, timeout=timeout)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)
    if code != 0:
        return None, stderr.strip() or f"exit {code}"
    try:
        return json.loads(stdout), None
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        return None, f"invalid JSON: {exc}"


def approved_queue_info() -> dict[str, Any]:
    info: dict[str, Any] = {"exists": APPROVED_QUEUE.exists(), "path": str(APPROVED_QUEUE)}
    if not APPROVED_QUEUE.exists():
        return info
    stat = APPROVED_QUEUE.stat()
    text = APPROVED_QUEUE.read_text(errors="replace")
    info["mtime_utc"] = datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime, timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    info["age_hours"] = round((time.time() - stat.st_mtime) / 3600, 2)
    info["approved_token_count"] = len(re.findall("approved", text, re.I))
    info["github_url_count"] = len(re.findall(r"https://github.com/[^\s\]\")]+", text))
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
        if isinstance(data, list):
            items = data
        elif isinstance(data, dict):
            items = data.get("items") or data.get("issues") or data.get("candidates") or []
        else:
            items = []
        info["items_count"] = len(items) if isinstance(items, list) else 0
        info["uploadable_true_count"] = sum(1 for item in items if isinstance(item, dict) and (item.get("uploadable") is True or item.get("approved") is True))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        info["json_error"] = str(exc)
    return info


def maintenance_memory_state() -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
    if not MAINTENANCE_MEMORY.exists():
        return False, None
    head = MAINTENANCE_MEMORY.read_text(errors="replace")[:2000].lower()
    match = re.search(r"last_completed_campaign:\s*([^\s]+)", head)
    return "active_campaign: true" in head, match.group(1) if match else None


def maintenance_memory_active() -> bool:
    active, _last_completed = maintenance_memory_state()
    return active


def dependency_has_early_signal(node: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if maintenance_category(node) != "dependency-bot":
        return False
    lower_labels = [label.lower() for label in labels(node)]
    text = node_text(node)
    signal_terms = (
        "security",
        "major",
        "breaking",
        "breaking-change",
        "failing-check",
        "failed check",
        "ci failure",
        "agent:needs-attention",
        "needs attention",
        "needs-attention",
    )
    return any(term in text for term in signal_terms) or any(
        any(term in label for term in signal_terms) for label in lower_labels
    )


def maintenance_early_start_reason(
    maintenance: Counter[str],
    pr_nodes: list[dict[str, Any]],
    active_campaign: bool,
    last_completed_campaign: str | None,
) -> str | None:
    if active_campaign:
        return "active campaign already recorded"
    if maintenance.get("sync-generated", 0) > 0:
        return f"sync-generated wave ({maintenance['sync-generated']})"
    if maintenance.get("dev-tool-sync", 0) > 0:
        return f"dev-tool-sync wave ({maintenance['dev-tool-sync']})"
    if maintenance.get("dependency-bot", 0) >= 5:
        return f"dependency-bot threshold ({maintenance['dependency-bot']})"
    if last_completed_campaign:
        parsed = parse_iso(last_completed_campaign)
        if parsed is not None and time.time() - parsed >= MAINTENANCE_EARLY_START_SECONDS:
            return "last completed campaign age >= 6 days"
    for node in pr_nodes:
        if repo(node) in {EXCLUDED_REPO, ADMIN_REPO}:
            continue
        if dependency_has_early_signal(node):
            return f"dependency PR signal ({repo(node)}#{node.get('number')})"
    return None


def quiet_counts(issue_signal: bool, maintenance_signal: bool, orphan_signal: bool) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    previous = (0, 0, 0)
    for _ts, body in memory_sections():
        match = re.search(
            r"Consecutive quiet counts: issue workloop `?(\d+)`?; maintenance lane `?(\d+)`?.*?orphan PR steward `?(\d+)`?",
            body,
            re.S,
        )
        if match:
            previous = tuple(int(match.group(i)) for i in range(1, 4))  # type: ignore[assignment]
            break
    issue_q = 0 if issue_signal else previous[0] + 1
    maint_q = 0 if maintenance_signal else previous[1] + 1
    orphan_q = 0 if orphan_signal else previous[2] + 1
    return issue_q, maint_q, orphan_q


def latest_orphan_worker_noop_is_fresh() -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
    if not ORPHAN_MEMORY.exists():
        return False, None
    text = ORPHAN_MEMORY.read_text(errors="replace")
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"^##\s+(\S+)\s*$", text, re.M))
    if not matches:
        return False, None
    first = matches[0]
    end = matches[1].start() if len(matches) > 1 else len(text)
    ts = first.group(1)
    parsed = parse_iso(ts)
    if parsed is None or time.time() - parsed > ORPHAN_WORKER_NOOP_FRESH_SECONDS:
        return False, ts
    body = text[first.start() : end]
    if "actionable_orphan_steward_scope=0" in body and "Selected target: none" in body:
        return True, ts
    return False, ts


def format_schedules(schedules: dict[str, Schedule]) -> str:
    return "; ".join(f"{name} `{sched.status}` / `{sched.rrule}`" for name, sched in schedules.items())


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    # The demand planner is read-only for automation settings. The Luna task
    # applies its full configurations through the app's automation_update tool.
    import demand_router
    return demand_router.main(argv)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
